source: NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) v5.0, published 2017-11-27, U.S. Department of Health and Human Services / National Cancer Institute, https://evs.nci.nih.gov/ftp1/CTCAE/CTCAE_5.0/ (file CTCAE_v5.0_2017-11-27.xlsx, sheet 'CTCAE v5.0 Clean Copy'), retrieved 2026-10-10. Only the 10 rows this instrument uses are extracted.
rationale: AEDECOD on the AE draft uses the CTCAE v5.0 term name so a pharma reviewer recognizes it. Grade definitions are shown as hover text to help the investigator confirm or change the provisional grade; they are NOT used by the rules engine (the provisional grade comes from the PRO-CTCAE composite). meddra_code_mock is a clearly-labeled placeholder: MedDRA is a licensed dictionary and Interim does not ship MedDRA codes; a production deployment maps AEDECOD through its licensed MedDRA version. Grades 4 and 5 are never assigned by Interim.

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by an uncomfortable sensation of difficulty breathing.

grade_definitions.1: Shortness of breath with moderate exertion
grade_definitions.2: Shortness of breath with minimal exertion; limiting instrumental ADL
grade_definitions.3: Shortness of breath at rest; limiting self care ADL

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by sudden, often repetitive, spasmodic contraction of the thoracic cavity, resulting in violent release of air from the lungs and usually accompanied by a distinctive sound.

grade_definitions.2: Moderate symptoms, medical intervention indicated; limiting instrumental ADL
grade_definitions.3: Severe symptoms; limiting self care ADL

terms.meddra_soc: General disorders and administration site conditions
terms.definition: A disorder characterized by a state of generalized weakness with a pronounced inability to summon sufficient energy to accomplish daily activities.

grade_definitions.2: Fatigue not relieved by rest; limiting instrumental ADL
grade_definitions.3: Fatigue not relieved by rest, limiting self care ADL

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by a queasy sensation and/or the urge to vomit.

grade_definitions.1: Loss of appetite without alteration in eating habits
grade_definitions.2: Oral intake decreased without significant weight loss, dehydration or malnutrition
grade_definitions.3: Inadequate oral caloric or fluid intake; tube feeding, TPN, or hospitalization indicated

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by an increase in frequency and/or loose or watery bowel movements.

grade_definitions.1: Increase of <4 stools per day over baseline; mild increase in ostomy output compared to baseline
grade_definitions.2: Increase of 4 - 6 stools per day over baseline; moderate increase in ostomy output compared to baseline; limiting instrumental ADL
grade_definitions.3: Increase of >=7 stools per day over baseline; hospitalization indicated; severe increase in ostomy output compared to baseline; limiting self care ADL

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by the presence of macules (flat) and papules (elevated). Also known as morbillform rash, it is one of the most common cutaneous adverse events, frequently affecting the upper trunk, spreading centripetally and associated with pruritis.

grade_definitions.1: Macules/papules covering <10% BSA with or without symptoms (e.g., pruritus, burning, tightness)
grade_definitions.2: Macules/papules covering 10 - 30% BSA with or without symptoms (e.g., pruritus, burning, tightness); limiting instrumental ADL; rash covering > 30% BSA with or without mild symptoms
grade_definitions.3: Macules/papules covering >30% BSA with moderate or severe symptoms; limiting self care ADL

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by an intense itching sensation.

grade_definitions.1: Mild or localized; topical intervention indicated
grade_definitions.2: Widespread and intermittent; skin changes from scratching (e.g., edema, papulation, excoriations, lichenification, oozing/crusts); oral intervention indicated; limiting instrumental ADL
grade_definitions.3: Widespread and constant; limiting self care ADL or sleep; systemic corticosteroid or immunosuppressive therapy indicated

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by a sensation of marked discomfort in a joint.

grade_definitions.3: Severe pain; limiting self care ADL

terms.meddra_soc: General disorders and administration site conditions
terms.definition: A disorder characterized by elevation of the body's temperature above the upper limit of normal.

grade_definitions.3: >40.0 degrees C (>104.0 degrees F) for <=24 hrs
grade_definitions.4: >40.0 degrees C (>104.0 degrees F) for >24 hrs

terms.note: Our instrument asks about fever OR chills as one yes/no item; chills has its own CTCAE term but this instrument maps the combined item to Fever. The typed temperature (if any) is evidence only; the provisional grade comes from the participant's yes/no answer.

terms.definition: A disorder characterized by ulceration or inflammation of the oral mucosal.

grade_definitions.1: Asymptomatic or mild symptoms; intervention not indicated
grade_definitions.2: Moderate pain or ulcer that does not interfere with oral intake; modified diet indicated
grade_definitions.3: Severe pain; interfering with oral intake
